narrative: Escalating Middle East tensions dominate weekend headlines after Iranian naval mine reports lifted crude toward $120, setting up an energy-driven bid for petro-currencies at Sunday's open. USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4004, facing continued downward pressure as oil resilience combines with potential US tariff relief on Canadian goods. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1204; a +146bp OIS carry deficit against the dollar leaves the pair vulnerable ahead of Wednesday's FOMC decision.
